note: No GitHub push, Vercel deploy, Figma publish, Canva publish, or Pump.fun submission is approved from this file. Use it only after the user explicitly approves the named action.

actions.label: Publish GitHub source
actions.publicEffect: Makes the VibeProof source and delivery artifacts available through GitHub.

actions.label: Deploy Vercel preview
actions.publicEffect: Creates a public Vercel preview URL for the Vite app.
requiredAfter: Set VIBEPROOF_URL to the Vercel preview URL

actions.label: Refresh deployed screenshots and visuals
actions.publicEffect: Updates local evidence to show the deployed URL rather than localhost.
actions.preparedCommand: $env:VIBEPROOF_URL='https://YOUR-VERCEL-PREVIEW-URL'; npm run vibeproof:capture; npm run vibeproof:visuals; Remove-Item Env:VIBEPROOF_URL
requiredBefore: user explicitly approves deployed screenshot refresh

actions.label: Create or publish Figma proof frame
actions.publicEffect: Creates or shares a Figma proof frame for reviewer scanning.
actions.preparedCommand: Use Figma connector after explicit approval
requiredBefore: user explicitly approves Figma creation or publication
requiredAfter: Record Figma URL in delivery/vibeproof/submission-assets-manifest.json, or leave optional/TODO if skipped

actions.label: Create or publish Canva submission visuals
actions.publicEffect: Creates Canva support visuals for the bounty submission.
actions.preparedCommand: Use Canva connector after explicit approval
requiredBefore: user explicitly approves Canva creation or publication
requiredAfter: Record Canva URL in delivery/vibeproof/submission-assets-manifest.json, or leave optional/TODO if skipped

actions.label: Verify final public submission package
actions.publicEffect: No direct public effect; verifies public URLs before Pump.fun submission.
requiredBefore: user explicitly approves final public verification run

actions.label: Submit Pump.fun reply
actions.publicEffect: Publishes the final bounty reply on Pump.fun.
excludedScope: automatic submission without final user approval
actions.preparedCommand: Manual/Browser submission only after explicit final approval
requiredBefore: user explicitly approves final Pump.fun copy
requiredAfter: Record Pump.fun reply URL in delivery/vibeproof/submission-assets-manifest.json if available
